items.source:
Can be thrown at any time during handler processing.
This includes any template methods of pre-built controllers.
For example, a form controller might abort to a specific error page
if certain parameters do not allow to proceed with the normal workflow.
items.translation: 可在处理器处理期间的任何时刻抛出。这包括预建控制器的任何模板方法。例如，如果某些参数不允许继续正常工作流程，表单控制器可能会中止并跳转到特定的错误页面。

items.source:
Create new ModelAndViewDefiningException with the given ModelAndView,
typically representing a specific error page.
items.translation: 创建新的 ModelAndViewDefiningException，并传入给定的 ModelAndView，通常代表特定的错误页面。

items.source: Return the ModelAndView that this exception contains for forwarding to.
items.translation: 返回该异常中包含的用于转发的 ModelAndView。

items.source: modelAndView - the ModelAndView with view to forward to and model to expose
items.translation: modelAndView - 包含要转发视图和要暴露模型的 ModelAndView
